_what_this_is: C-BRAIN-1 Part 5b: the portion one agents turn takes, and the memory thresholds
for the heavy things (5f). Read by core.turn.portion(); a missing key RAISES.
Every number carries the measurement it was set from.

verify_per_turn.why: the agents turn of 1 Oct 2026 18:42-20:19 UTC took 62 needs at 94.6 s each (mean; median 87 s, from the TAKEN rows of memory/vertical_ledger.jsonl). 59 VERIFY needs were open: all of them = 93 minutes. 10, with the 9 open FIND needs, keeps the turn near 30 minutes; the rest wait, longest-waiting first next turn.

maintenance_cells_per_turn.why: a maintenance cell is one search at the same ~95 s; 5 cells = about 8 minutes. It was 10 before (--maintenance default), which never ran: the turn crashed at 20:20 after 62 needs.

embed_min_free_gb.why: free RAM fell to 273 MB on 1 Oct 2026 with Chrome (two profiles), Ollama and the embedding pass together. The pass sleeps below 1.5 GB and while the baton is AGENTS.

extractor_min_free_gb.why: GLiNER2 large on CPU (torch) is loaded only in the brain's turn and only with at least 2 GB free; below it: EXTRACTOR_SKIPPED_LOW_MEMORY.
